thread.text:
Today: Squat came in heavier than prescribed — 80kg for all three work sets (5,5,5) instead of holding 70kg for 8–10 reps. No knee complaints logged this time, so pain-wise it looks clean at that load, but reps sat well short of the target range and the rotate progression box isn't ticked. Kneeling Leg Curl dropped from 10kg to 7.5kg mid-session (10kg×8, then 7.5kg×10, 10), with nothing in the log explaining the change. Leg Extension is a new addition not in the prescription, so it has no comparison history yet. Hollow Body Hold held 1:00 on the first two sets before falling to 0:30.

Trend: 80kg on squat has now appeared twice — 09-12 at 80kg×5 with knee pain, today at 80kg×5,5,5 with none flagged. That's more volume at the same load, but the prescribed "70kg for reps, not plates" approach still hasn't actually been run. Kneeling Leg Curl has sat around 10kg across three sessions without clearing 12 reps on all sets — worth calling stalled on that rotate slot.

Right lat: 0/10, but there was no pulling work today, so this reading doesn't feed the row protocol either way.

Rounding: Deadlift, Leg Press, Seated Calf Raise and Hanging Leg Raise are all absent from today's log — four of six prescribed slots. Some of that may just not have been logged, but it's worth a note.

Next session: Upper A, Monday. Incline Bench leads at 65kg, chasing 8 reps across all four sets — 09-21 landed 8,7 on the back half, so that's the bar to clear. Pull-ups go second, straight after incline, while fresh.

Question: What happened to the deadlift today — swapped out, or skipped?
